findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "ask_human_developer" references sensitive artifacts (password, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "ask_human_developer" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Connect the user with a real, manually approved human developer. Use it when the user asks for a human, a code review, a consultation or hands-on help, or when you have made a real attempt at their software problem and it is still not solved or is beyond what you can do reliably (unclear requirement" → after: "Saves a draft request to a real, manually approved human developer: a question, a code review, a consultation or hands-on help with a software problem. It takes a short summary in plain words, which must not contain passwords, API keys, tokens or other secrets. Only a draft is saved: nothing reaches"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
